selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods; territorial and constitutional events are identity context only and local ratings do not inherit UK-wide sports evidence.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
UK-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No football federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Territorial, constitutional and treaty events are context only, not sports-performance evidence.
For IOT, the 2025 UK-Mauritius treaty is not applied as a sovereignty transition before entry into force.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
